# stb_image / stb_image_write

Single-header image libraries by Sean Barrett, used only for reading and writing image files
(allowed by the brief). Nothing to install: `image_utils.cpp` compiles them in.

| File | Version | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `stb_image.h` | v2.32 | https://github.com/nothings/stb (downloaded 2026-11-15) |
| `stb_image_write.h` | v1.18 | https://github.com/nothings/stb (downloaded 2026-11-15) |

Licence: public domain (Unlicense) or MIT, at your choice — see the end of each file.
The files are kept unmodified so they can be updated by copying newer versions over them.
